d: Bisleri one of India's most popular packaged drinking water brands, has come under scrutiny after its water reportedly failed quality tests twice. Laboratory investigations allegedly detected potentially harmful chemicals, raising serious concerns about the safety and quality of bottled drinking water. The findings have sparked questions about quality control, consumer safety and regulatory oversight.
